role_slug.description: A single role identifier. Defaults to `member` or the explicit default role. Mutually exclusive with `role_slugs`.

rationale: The single-role_slug member is selected and its not constraint is removed because that constraint is not representable after capability narrowing.

provenance.observed: The referenced request schema offers absent, single-role_slug, and role_slugs variants with exclusion constraints.
provenance.specd: The SDK update request supports the single role_slug member as a plain object body.
